AR.name: Marcela
AR.citation: Flora Argentina (buscador.floraargentina.edu.ar), official national flora database; also documented as marcela hembra, marcela manzanilla, vira-vira, virá-vira guazu. Guarani name jate'i ka'a also documented in Argentina (SIB, Parques Nacionales)

BO.name: Huira huira
BO.citation: Alonso & Desmarchelier (2015), Plantas Medicinales Autoctonas de la Argentina - country-tagged regional name; also documented as Quechua wira wira across the Andean region

BR.name: Macela
BR.citation: Kinupp, V.F. (2007), Plantas alimenticias nao-convencionais da regiao metropolitana de Porto Alegre, RS, Brazil; genuinely native, flowers used in southern Brazil to stuff baby pillows for a believed calming effect (iNaturalist Chile/Ecuador species accounts)

CO.name: Vira vira
CO.citation: Alonso & Desmarchelier (2015), Plantas Medicinales Autoctonas de la Argentina - country-tagged regional name; also documented as juan blanco. Native range confirmed to Colombia (Wikipedia: native from Argentina to Colombia to Guyana)

EC.name: Marcela
EC.citation: Native range confirmed (iNaturalist Ecuador); pan-regional Spanish name shared with neighboring Peru/Colombia, no Ecuador-specific citation found beyond range confirmation

PE.name: Marcela
PE.citation: Native range confirmed (Wikipedia, iNaturalist); pan-regional Spanish name, no Peru-specific citation found beyond range confirmation

PY.name: Marcela
PY.citation: Caceres & Machain Singer (2001), Manual de Uso de Hierbas Medicinales del Paraguay - matching Guarani name 'Marcela'. Widely used medicinally among Guarani-heritage communities across Paraguay, Uruguay and northern Argentina for gastrointestinal disorders (edibleplantdb.org, citing Lim 2016)

UY.name: Marcela blanca
UY.citation: Alonso & Desmarchelier (2015), Plantas Medicinales Autoctonas de la Argentina - country-tagged regional name. Flowers used in Uruguay to stuff baby pillows for a believed calming effect

VE.name: Viravilona
VE.citation: Alonso & Desmarchelier (2015), Plantas Medicinales Autoctonas de la Argentina - country-tagged regional name
